provenance: full model output from a direct run: every pixel's pre-argmax scores, read from the run's raster and pooled to windows by olmoearth-inferencex; not Studio point samples
signal: the package's window confidence, the mean over the window's valid pixels of the top-1 minus top-2 logit margin, label-fill channel left out (lower = more suspect)
row_encoding: each row holds the window's confidence at its majority class and 0 at every other class (exp64's mapping), so a row's top-1 minus top-2 is the package's window confidence and its arg-max the window's class

fill_class.name: nodata_value_9
fill_class.note: channel 9 is the label fill value (the task's nodata_value), never a training target; it is kept because the served argmax runs over every channel
fill_class.effect: left out of the margin and the class vote: a window is ranked on its real classes
